title: Cordless Portable Blender For Shakes & Smoothies, Personal Juicer Cup,  BPA-Free Bottle With LED Display, Self-Cleaning Ice Crusher
body_html:
1. FOUR SPEED MODES, ONE CUP FOR EVERYTHING This 2-in-1 blender and juicer gives you four gear settings matched to four blending times. Smoothies, protein shakes, fresh juice, baby food and frozen drinks all come out silky. One button, one cup, done.

2. 22,000 RPM MOTOR + SELF-CLEANING A high-torque motor spins up to 22,000 RPM to break down ice and frozen fruit in seconds, and it runs quietly. Add water, tap self-clean, and the cup rinses itself. No scrubbing, no soaking.

3. TRIPLE SAFETY PROTECTION It shuts off on its own after 5 seconds of idling, stops the moment something jams the blades, and will not start at all unless the cup is locked onto the base. Safe even when you are half asleep at 6 a.m.

4. FOOD-GRADE AND BPA-FREE Food-grade PP + ABS cup, 12 food-grade stainless steel blades, BPA-free throughout. No plastic smell, no aftertaste, and nothing leaching into your morning smoothie.

5. LIGHTWEIGHT WITH LONG BATTERY LIFE Only 490 g, and shaped to sit in a bag or a car cup holder. Long-lasting fast-charge battery with an LED display that shows the remaining charge. Top it up from a wall adapter, a car charger or a power bank.

Product Description

Fresh smoothies, anywhere.

This cordless portable blender packs a 22,000 RPM motor, 12 food-grade stainless steel blades and a 450 ml BPA-free cup into one lightweight body you can carry in one hand.

Four speed modes let you match the blend to the job — a few seconds for a quick protein shake, longer for ice and frozen fruit.

The LED display keeps an eye on the battery level. The self-cleaning mode means you add water, tap, and you're done.

Safety is built in. It stops on its own after 5 seconds of idling. It stops instantly if anything jams the blades. And it won't start until the cup is locked onto the base.

At 490 g it slips into a backpack, a gym bag or a car cup holder. Charge it from a wall outlet, a car charger or a power bank.

Breakfast at home. A shake after the gym. Juice at the office. Anytime, anywhere.

title: Imperial Green Necklace, Chinese Style Gourd Pendant Necklace, Full Green Natural Chalcedony, Amulet For Peace, Agate Safety Buckle, Jade Pendant
body_html:
Imperial Green Jadeite Pendant Necklace Collection

Overview
Indulge in the timeless elegance of this exquisite Imperial Green Jadeite Pendant Collection. Each piece features a premium, vibrant green jadeite cabochon, meticulously selected for its intense color saturation, rich translucency, and flawless, velvety smooth finish. Symbolizing wealth, longevity, and good fortune, these heirloom-quality necklaces blend traditional cultural heritage with modern luxury, making them perfect for both formal events and upscale daily wear.

Design Options Available

1. The Auspicious Calabash Pendant
- Symbolism: Represents infinite blessings, good fortune, and protection.
- Craftsmanship: Features a plump, voluptuous double-tier gourd carved from translucent green jadeite.
- Accents: Available in a classic variant with a minimalist white gold bail adorned with a single diamond accent, or a luxury variant entirely framed in a shimmering pavé diamond halo setting.

2. The Classic Safety Coin Pendant
- Symbolism: A timeless talisman signifying safety, peace, and domestic harmony.
- Craftsmanship: A perfectly balanced, circular green jadeite disc with a polished hole at its center.
- Accents: Anchored by a central sparkling diamond accent point and suspended from a delicate, finely crafted white gold chain.

3. The Majestic Imperial Tablet Pendant
- Symbolism: Represents a smooth life journey free of obstacles or trouble.
- Craftsmanship: A sleek, minimalist rectangular tablet boasting full, uniform color distribution and top-tier luster.
- Setting: Lavishly encased within an opulent, architectural multi-row brilliant-cut diamond border that creates a captivating contrast against the deep emerald-green jade.

Key Specifications
- Gemstone Type: Authentic Natural Grade A Jadeite
- Color Grade: Imperial Vivid Green
- Metal Setting: Premium 18K White Gold or Platinum
- Side Stones: Selected High-Clarity Round Brilliant Diamonds
- Chain Style: High-polish diamond-cut cable chain with a secure clasp.
